program_title: Master of Science in Computer Science and Engineering-EWU
major_area_policy: A student must declare their major area during enrollment into the program. However, a student can change their major area before the start of the second semester with the permission of the Chairperson of the Department.
admission_requirements: Minimum GPA of 2.50 in both SSC and HSC Examinations.

Candidates must have passed University of London and Cambridge GCE O Level in at least five subjects and A Level in at least two subjects. Only the best five subjects in O Level and best two subjects in A Level will be considered.

Out of the seven GCE subjects, a candidate must have at least 4 B grades or GPA of 4.00 in four subjects and 3 C grades or GPA of 3.5 in the remaining three subjects, based on A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2 and E=1.

Candidates must have a 4-year Bachelor degree in Computer Science and Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information and Communications Engineering, or an equivalent discipline with a minimum CGPA of 2.5 on a 4.0 point scale or equivalent standing from a recognized institution.
Candidates from any engineering discipline must have completed calculus, statistics, and programming prerequisites.
Candidates from any physical, mathematical, or biological science discipline must have completed calculus, statistics, and programming prerequisites.
Candidates must have passed HSC or an equivalent program from the Science group.
Candidates must pass an admission test administered by the university.
study_track_policy: A student must declare their study track during enrollment into the program. However, a student can change their study track during the progress of the program with the permission of the Chairperson of the Department.

ewu_program.program_name: MSS in Sociology and Social Policy (MSSP)

offering_entity.name: Department of Sociology and Social Policy

requirements.condition: Students seeking admission to the MSS in Sociology and Social Policy Program must have completed their undergraduate degree in any discipline from UGC-approved universities.
Students with a BSS in Sociology, Social Sciences, or equivalent degrees will be given preference for admission.
Students with 3-year BA degrees with a CGPA of 3.0 are eligible for admission.
Minimum GPA of 2.50 in both SSC and HSC examinations.
A minimum CGPA of 2.5 on a 4.0-point scale or equivalent standing in an Honors degree from any recognized institution.
Candidates must have passed University of London and Cambridge GCE O Level in at least five subjects and A Level in at least two subjects.
Only the best five subjects in O Level and the best two subjects in A Level will be considered.
Among the seven subjects, candidates must have at least four Bs or GPA 4.00 in four subjects and three Cs or GPA 3.5 in the remaining three subjects.
Applicants with at least one year's experience in a public, private, NGO, or development-sector program/project shall receive priority in admission.
Final selection of candidates for admission to the MSSP program will be based on admission assessment scores.
There is no age limit for admission.

program_structure.description: The MSS in Sociology and Social Policy program is a 1-year program offered by the Department of Sociology. The three semesters combine compulsory/core and elective interdisciplinary courses.

degree_requirement.requirement: As per UGC, East West University, and Sociology Department policy.

components.additional_requirement: Students must complete another elective course of 4 credits.

financial_information.summary: The total tuition and listed fees are approximately BDT 2,04,500.
